title: Officials give Jameis Winston a TD, replays appear to show he was down before scoring

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Officials give Jameis Winston a TD, replays appear to show he was down before scoring
sources.description: The officials gave Giants quarterback Jameis Winston a touchdown on a fourth-and-goal tush push today against the Jaguars, but on replay it's not at all clear that Winston actually scored.
